_readme: The OUTBOUND render spec: how the workspace-native ./pkg becomes the public
github.com/zama-ai/fhevm-hardhat-template repository. The workspace copy is optimized for
developing in lockstep with the cluster (file: links, no solhint); the render is optimized for
being cloned. `publish-mirror` (planned) consumes this spec: clone -> branch -> render + version
gate -> PR. Until it lands, this file is the committed record of every deliberate divergence,
Every entry answers: what differs between ./pkg and the public repo, and why.

identity.name: fhevm-hardhat-template
identity.reason: The workspace copy is named fhevm-hardhat-template-v2 to say which generation it is; the public repo keeps the historical name.

@fhevm/hardhat-plugin.public: registry range of the released plugin
@fhevm/hardhat-plugin.reason: Live cluster link in the workspace; a clone installs from the registry.

@fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext.reason: Unpublished chain today; the render is blocked on the chain publishing.

solhint.public: ^6.2.1 devDependency, plus the lint:sol script re-chained into lint
solhint.reason: solhint's import-path-check resolves only the package-local node_modules; under workspace hoisting it cannot pass without a symlink, and symlinks are banned. The check belongs to the clone-shaped layer: the rendered repo and test-consumer.

lint.workspace: npm run lint:ts && npm run prettier:check
lint.public: npm run lint:sol && npm run lint:ts && npm run prettier:check

extras.note: Files that exist ONLY in the public repo, to be stored under ./mirror-extras when publish-mirror lands.

lockfile.reason: The workspace form has no own lockfile (the cluster lock covers it); a clone needs one, produced by an isolated registry install at render time.
